  <h1>Basic ω-regular closure</h1>
  <p>Omega-power restarts after every finite block, concatenation hands off after a finite prefix, and union makes an initial nondeterministic choice. Intersection alternates between waiting for the two Büchi final sets, accepting after each completed round.</p>
